protocol.status: minimal-head and label-free gated signed-read test
protocol.frozen_parent_boundary: Head-budget reallocation is insufficient but signed affine value mixing closes the tangent gap; isolate the minimal heads and test a gated residual/signed-value read.

subset_calibration.role: replay of Level 6.19.3 data; all 255 subsets

subset_rule.quantity: equal-L2 actual deployed-margin gain after frozen nonlinear downstream replay of masked per-head components; first-order gain is secondary
subset_rule.enumeration: all 255 non-empty subsets of eight read heads
subset_rule.selection: smallest subset meeting threshold; then maximum recovery; then lexicographic head order

simplex_audit.target: the full equal-L2 signed-affine context delta
simplex_audit.solver: two-start projected gradient for the convex least-squares projection onto the product of eight 32-slot simplices
simplex_audit.interpretation: tests exact target representability, not every possible equal-dose simplex direction

routers.common: same input-conditioned slot scorer, head mask, parameter count, training split, optimizer, and global dose cap
routers.nonnegative: valid softmax attention followed by source interpolation
routers.training_objective: task cross-entropy plus fixed-weight distillation toward the selected-subset signed Oracle context delta

decision_rule.specificity: all six positive after Holm correction at 0.05
decision_rule.success: signed router reaches recovery threshold, passes specificity, and the lower full-accuracy CI exceeds the noninferiority bound

diagnosis.registered_next_boundary: Keep the trunk frozen; diagnose router observability and supervision rather than reopening optimizer or model search.
